errors.message: Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: {"error":"unauthorized","hint":"Send exactly `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — that scheme, that spelling, one space; a bare token or a lowercase `bearer` is rejected the same way a wrong one is. Mint a token in Settings at https://growthradar.app/settings, or connect with OAuth (no pasted token): the server advertises /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. tools/list and resources/read need no token — use them to check the server is alive before blaming the credential."}
